reason: A desktop launcher plugin that generates macOS and Linux entry points for starting dsh, polling its local Web UI, and optionally opening the interface in a browser.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 生成 macOS 应用和 Linux 桌面入口，以便双击启动本地 Web UI 并可选地自动打开浏览器。
summaries.en: Generates macOS and Linux desktop launchers for starting the local dsh Web UI and optionally opening it in a browser.

capabilities: Creates and updates desktop launcher files on macOS and Linux
Executes a configured local dsh startup command
Polls a local Web UI URL and optionally opens it in a browser
Backs up unmanaged existing launcher files before replacement
